description: This is a jet propulsion module used in military fighter jets.  It provides extremely high thrust.
This is a vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) propulsion system used in military VTOL aircraft.  It provides both lift for taking off and thrust when in the air.

This is an experimental hover repulsor module mounted on the underside of a vehicle.  It allows the vehicle to glide and fly over rough terrain and obstacles.  Though originally thought to be frictionless, unknown antigrav phenomena nonetheless causes vehicles to experience a force similar to friction when near the ground.
